objective: Sell and deliver two bounded USD 500 AI Clip Assembly pilots using existing customer-controlled footage and project-owned video proof, without promising new generation, native editor files, performance results, or unlimited revisions.

source_need.published_scope: Combine six existing AI-generated clips totalling about 32 seconds into one 30-45 second cinematic brand film and one 25-30 second website cut, with colour, music, sound, selected shot repair, high-resolution exports, and editable project files.
source_need.demand_interpretation: A current buyer has attached a USD 500 budget to a bounded six-clip assembly problem. This validates the problem and price point, not LazyingArt demand or a likely award.

offer.scope: Up to six customer-controlled AI-generated clips and 45 seconds of combined source; one 30-45 second 16:9 master; one 25-30 second 16:9 web cut derived from the same edit; basic colour continuity; one music and sound pass; simple supplied titles or logo; H.264 MP4 exports; a source manifest; and one consolidated correction pass.
exclusions: Native Premiere Pro, After Effects, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve project delivery unless the accepted scope names and confirms the format
offer.qualification: Begin with a brief, source metadata, rights status, and private previews. Agree the story sentence, usable clips, native-project requirement, delivery, source handling, correction, cancellation, refund, and payment terms before original source transfer or payment.

proof.claim_boundary: Every public example is first-party project work. None is a customer brand film, paid UGC campaign, e-commerce performance result, or proof that six unseen source clips will fit.

owned_content.title: Six AI Clips Are Not a Brand Film: A Practical Assembly Pass
owned_content.validation: The source and both translation pages returned HTTP 200 with the correct localized title and one original tracked offer link.
owned_content.policy: The article teaches source inventory, shot roles, silent assembly, sound, text, export, and reproducible handoff before one restrained offer. It contains no prospect details or customer-result claim.

gaps: Higgsfield experience is preferred but not claimed.
